relationship_to_R6: After R6 360-child development audit, freeze approved R6 candidate and pretested SHA before third-party source reveal; no inference that own GitHub Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 are independent administrators.

prior_contact.kind: Already-contacted SAT Competition organizers asking for independent expert/lab referral; do not assume organizers are willing custodians.

selection_requirements.operator: Independent university/lab researcher, controls their own machine, tests and private signing key; explicit verified permission before intake.
selection_requirements.candidate_freeze: Separate signed version/hash of source code, R6 selected policy, FIT.json, complete list of dependencies and benchmark scripts. Do not present R6 public set as blind.
selection_requirements.sample: At least 20 previously unmeasured CNF originals across >=4 independent families, including exact random XOR widths3-6, mixed XOR with residual, partial XOR and plain 3SAT; additionally externally checked UNSAT if a solver provides portable proofs.
selection_requirements.sealed_manifest: Custodian chooses source instances/labels/seeds and publishes independent time-stamped SHA256 commitment before any candidate execution or reveal.
selection_requirements.hash_and_identity: Public operator identity and Ed25519 public key authorized out-of-band; signatures and canonical CNF SHA linked; do not trust a self-nominated key in a receipt.
selection_requirements.conflict_and_leakage: Reject any overlap/isomorphisms or generator-seed family leaked to R1-R6 training, dev or PR artifacts.
selection_requirements.fairness: Original CNF identical across arms; full-cold startup, structural profiling, original CNF SAT witness replay included; >=5 randomized repeats per source per arm; bounded CPU/RAM/wall, identical host, software version and single-thread rules.
comparators: CryptoMiniSat native XOR only when a complete proven source XOR cover exists
One more independent modern SAT/CDCL baseline if accessible
selection_requirements.correctness: For SAT independently replay EVERY original clause. For UNSAT require independently checked portable LRAT/DRAT or equivalent; own-admin GF2 contradiction not enough.
selection_requirements.preserve: Every task, skipped decision, negative result, timeout, unsupported proof and cost included in signed raw results.
selection_requirements.gate: At least 2 distinct truly independent source families >=1.20x over best fully verified competitor, with <=10pct regret on EVERY source across independent environments; no censored baseline as infinite time.
selection_requirements.claim_ceiling: If passed, family-limited transfer candidate only until external reproducibility review; cannot infer P=NP or universal algorithm.

security: No secret, unpublished CNF, private Ed25519 key, access token or custodian identity guess is included in the repository.
